source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of feedback mechanisms (PDF 2-3).

blocks.text: Feedback mechanisms homeostasis ki buniyad hain. Yeh qaboo karne wale aise amal hain jin mein kisi system ka output (nateeja ya paidawar) khud usi system ke kaam ko qaboo karne mein istemal hota hai. Feedback mechanisms ki do qismein hain.
